attempts.summary: Stood up a fresh 3-member etcd cluster (v3.6.10) across node1/node2/node3 on Alpine, loaded it with application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd and irrecoverably wiped its data dir while node1/node2 retained quorum), then replaced it using the standard etcd member-remove/member-add procedure with a new member ID on the same node3 system (initial-cluster-state=existing). Verified all 3 members healthy and all application keys intact via the replaced member. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, preserving quorum at each step, and confirmed boot-id changes plus full etcd health/data recovery after each restart.
